Choose whether each page and section is available to Free and Subscribed members. Changes apply in this browser build; enforce the same rules on your production backend for real accounts.

Learning video library

Pose Library image manager

Select a gallery and upload up to 500 images per gallery. Images can be deleted individually. Stored in this browser's IndexedDB.

Upcoming Events manager

Add an event to Workshops, Seminar or Exhibitions. Add an image by URL or upload, and include a destination / registration link. Uploaded images are stored in this browser.
